Two bare matches found in check_storage_quota/3: (1) {:ok, current_usage} = get_storage_usage(prefix: prefix) — matches INV-8 grep pattern; get_storage_usage/1 always returns {:ok, _} so this cannot crash on a bad tagged tuple, but the bare match pattern is still flagged. No outbound HTTP call using tenant-controlled URL added.
